name: String Replace
description: Replace exact text in a sandbox file. Prefer this over patch for simple unique edits.

function.name: str_replace
function.description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. Prefer over patch for simple unique edits; prefer over write_file for surgical changes. Always read_file first and copy exact text. Fuzzy match handles smart quotes / escapes. count defaults to 1; use count=-1 to replace all. Fails if occurrence count does not match.

path.description: Relative path under the sandbox cwd.

old_string.description: Exact text to find. Include 1–2 lines of context so the match is unique.

new_string.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes old_string.

count.description: How many occurrences to replace (default 1). File must contain exactly this many matches unless count is -1 (replace all).
